title: Driving a Kubota Tractor Step-by-Step
reason: The video provides detailed instructions on how to safely operate a Kubota tractor.

tasks.task: Explain the initial steps to start the Kubota tractor safely.

subtasks.text: Ensure the tractor is parked on a flat and stable surface before getting in.
Sit in the seat, which activates the safety switch, to prepare for starting.

tasks.task: Describe the sequence for manually starting the engine.

subtasks.text: Locate the emergency or parking brake and engage it before starting.
Set the transmission to neutral and insert the key into the ignition to turn it on.
Preheat the engine if necessary by turning the key to the left and then start the engine by turning to the right.

tasks.task: Outline the process for operating the throttle and PTO.

subtasks.text: Adjust the throttle lever to control engine speed for different tasks.
Ensure the parking brake is released before moving the tractor.
Use the appropriate brake control based on the tractor's transmission type.

tasks.task: Provide guidance on steering and general operation.

subtasks.text: Use the steering wheel to control the direction, maintaining slow, deliberate movements.
Follow safety guidelines by avoiding sudden actions to prevent accidents.

tasks.task: Explain the use of PTO and other safety measures.

subtasks.text: Only engage the PTO when the implement is properly attached and the tractor is stationary.
Familiarize yourself with all controls, including the three-point hitch, for safe operation.
